messages:
alex_ops: Heads-up — vendor just told me there's a 2-week backorder on A100 80GB lot we requested. They can do a partial ship now but pricing and duties change if we split. cc @maria_procure @raj_sre

maria_procure: Price hold? or are they applying a surcharge for split POs?

nexasupply_julia: Confirmed from NEXA: base price holds on a single PO, but split shipments incur +3% handling plus customs/clearance per shipment. We can do: 40 units in ~10 days, remainder in ~21 days. AWBs will be separate for each departure.

raj_sre: For DOA/RMA path — will you provide provisional serial list before ship? We need SNs to stage firmware and to reserve RMA pool. Also any DOA SLA changes?

nexasupply_julia: We can provide a provisional SN list ~48h pre-departure and final manifest 24h before ETA. DOA procedure unchanged — expedited replacements from EU hub for EU deliveries, from US hub for US. RMA requires RM# on AWB and RM paperwork attached.

alex_ops: Operational constraints — EU dock capacity limited week of arrival, we cannot accept >40 GPUs in a single day. Can you stagger inbound slices (e.g., daily batches of ~8–10)? Also need install HVAC window blocked in calendar.

nexasupply_julia: Yes, we can stagger. Option A: daily batches 8–10 units for EU; Option B: hold remainder at our EU warehouse and release per call. Holding beyond 7 days incurs storage fees. We can do either — confirm which you prefer.

fin_amy: Need cost breakdown for storage / split paperwork. Finance needs line items before we approve.

nexasupply_julia: Line items: storage €15/unit/day after day 7; customs brokerage €90/shipment; certificate/CO handling €350/shipment; split handling surcharge +3% on unit price for shipments < full PO. Air freight expedite estimate provided separately.

maria_procure: Proposed plan: PO RINF-2026-045. 40 units to US (ship ~10d), 30 units to EU (we'll accept staggered release, hold for up to 7d then daily releases of 5), 10 units to be allocated as RMA pool/spares. Approve?

sanjay_infra: We have an urgent training job in EU. Can you expedite 6 GPUs from the EU allocation? If yes, ETA needed within ~72h.

nexasupply_julia: We can allocate 6 from the EU batch and expedite via air freight — ship in ~72h. Expedited cost +€1200/unit. We'll mark them 'expedite' and issue separate AWB. Revised proforma and ETA coming.

maria_procure: Please attach revised proforma and updated ETAs. Also clarify Incoterms for each leg — finance prefers DDP for EU if affordable.

nexasupply_julia: Proforma uploaded (link: https://nexa.example/proforma/NS-54021). Default Incoterms are DAP; we can switch EU leg to DDP for +€250/unit. AWB and proforma will reflect chosen terms once PO confirmed.

alex_ops: Action items: maria to confirm PO + incoterms; fin_amy to confirm budget for expedite and DDP; raj to confirm serial pre-list requirement in the ticketing system; I'll update install calendar and HVAC booking.

fin_amy: Budget OK for the 6 expedite units, approve up to €8k extra. DDP for EU leg approved from finance side.

maria_procure: PO RINF-2026-045 submitted in Ariba. Selected: EU leg DDP, US leg DAP. Vendor, please confirm final ETA and proforma number so we can match payment.

nexasupply_julia: Got PO, thanks. Proforma #NS-54021 sent to maria_procure@redwood.ai. ETAs: US batch ship date ~1845650000 (ETA ~10 days), EU expedited 6 ship date ~1845569720 (air freight, ~72h), remaining EU batch release starting in ~14 days. AWBs and provisional SN list will be uploaded to the PO portal 48h before each shipment.

raj_sre: Please ensure SN list includes MACs and PSU firmware versions if possible — that speeds staging. Also, include a sample manifest format for our ingress automation.

nexasupply_julia: Sample manifest snippet (we'll send full CSV in portal):
```
SKU,Serial,Model,FW,Destination,Qty
A100-80GB,NSX12345,A100-80,1.02,EU-DC-1,6
A100-80GB,NSX12346,A100-80,1.02,EU-DC-1,4
```
We'll include MACs/PSU FW where available.

alex_ops: Great — I'll block install slots and notify facilities. Keeping thread open for AWB and final manifest. :thumbsup:
